1: # 苏住房防台防汛 C 端
2: 
3: 使用 uni-app Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia，支持 H5 和微信小程序。参考项目仅用于 UI 设计，应用源码独立实现。
4: 
5: ## 已实现功能
6: 
7: - 工作台：左侧分类栏（综合查询 / 项目检查 / 防台防汛）+ 应用卡片网格 + 底部导航；非本期入口明确提示“该服务暂未开放”。
8: - 汛前、汛中、汛后检查：按检查类型分卡片渲染字段配置，支持日期、非负数量步进器、单选、备注、最多 6 张现场照片；汛中提供“紧急求救”浮标直达求援表单。
9: - 检查草稿：保存、刷新或重启后恢复、按检查类型隔离、提交成功后清除对应草稿。
10: - 历史记录：z-paging 分页（下拉刷新、上拉加载）、汛前/汛中/汛后页签、工单状态筛选、空态与失败提示；记录详情只读。
11: - 求援工单：联系人、手机号、紧急程度、险情和支援说明、照片验证、归档详情。
12: - 错误处理：存储失败保留原草稿、重复提交保护、照片保存失败重试/删除、不兼容存储数据明确报错。
13: 
14: ## UI 还原方式与结论
15: 
16: UI 以参考站点 `http://localhost:8443/` 为唯一视觉基准，做法是把参考站的运行态样式（尺寸、间距、圆角、阴影、颜色、字重、行高）逐条搬到 `src/styles/theme.css`，再用 Playwright 对同尺寸视口做**画布像素比对**（阈值 delta>24），输出差异像素比例与红色差异蒙层到 `artifacts/diff/`。
17: 
18: | 页面 | 差异像素 / 总像素 | 差异比例 |
19: |---|---|---|
20: | 工作台 | 0 / 329160 | **0%** |
21: | 汛中巡检 | 101 / 329160 | 0.031% |
22: | 汛前检查 | 1158 / 329160 | 0.352% |
23: 
24: - 工作台已达逐像素一致。其余页面的残差集中在输入框内文字与步进器数字，经 4 倍放大截图核对为**亚像素抗锯齿差异**（字形、字号、字重、位置一致），非布局或样式偏差。
25: - 字体与参考站完全相同：`Noto Sans SC` 与 `Plus Jakarta Sans` 的 Figma 托管 woff2，字体文件与加载方式均未做本地替换或降级。
26: 
27: ### 无法做到 100% 的部分及原因
28: 
29: 1. **原生控件由平台渲染**：参考站是 Figma Make 的 React 页面，用原生 `input`/`textarea`/`select`；uni-app 在 H5 渲染为 `uni-input`/`uni-number-box` 等，日期控件的原生日历图标、文本框缩放把手、占位符字色由浏览器与 uni-app 基础库决定，无法只用 CSS 完全对齐。
30: 2. **演示数据不同**：参考站预置了 14 条汛前工单等静态数据，本应用是真实空态起步（数据来自 store 与本机存储），列表与计数因此不会与参考站截图逐字相同。
31: 3. **参考站无对应页面的部分**：记录详情页为本应用新增（参考站只有列表与表单），其视觉沿用同一套 token 自行延伸。
32: 4. **微信小程序端无法与 H5 逐像素一致**：小程序渲染层不是浏览器，字体回退、`svg` 支持（需转 base64 或改用图片）、滚动条与安全区处理均不同。小程序端保证结构、间距、颜色与 H5 同源（同一份 `theme.css`），但需在开发者工具与真机上单独验收。
33: 
34: ## 本地运行
35: 
36: 环境：Node.js ≥22.12、Bun 1.4.4（已验证）。只使用根目录 `bun.lock`，不要在测试工具目录单独安装。
37: 
38: ```sh
39: bun install --frozen-lockfile
40: bun run dev:h5 --port 5188 --strictPort
41: bun run dev:mp-weixin
42: ```
43: 
44: 当前机器 Bun 尚未加入 PATH，PowerShell 可使用：
45: 
46: ```powershell
47: & "$env:USERPROFILE\.bun\bin\bun.exe" install --frozen-lockfile
48: & "$env:USERPROFILE\.bun\bin\bun.exe" run dev:h5 --port 5188 --strictPort
49: ```
50: 
51: H5：`http://127.0.0.1:5188/`。微信开发者工具导入开发产物 `dist/dev/mp-weixin`；生产产物为 `dist/build/mp-weixin`，发布前配置自己的微信 AppID、合法域名并进行真机验收。
52: 
53: ## 检查与构建
54: 
55: ```sh
56: bun run typecheck
57: bun run test
58: bun run build:h5
59: bun run build:mp-weixin
60: ```
61: 
62: H5 浏览器测试需先启动上述开发服务：
63: 
64: ```sh
65: bun x playwright install chromium
66: bun run test:e2e
67: ```
68: 
69: 可通过 `E2E_BASE_URL` 指定其他预览地址，或通过 `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE` 指定本机已有 Chromium。本次验证使用本机 Chromium 1243 对应版本，覆盖手机宽度 320、390、768 像素。截图输出到 `artifacts/workbench.png`，失败截图及 trace 输出到忽略目录 `test-results`。
70: 
71: ## 数据与接口边界
72: 
73: 数据流：页面 → Pinia store 公开 action → 请求/平台适配 → 外部数据源。页面不包含接口地址、业务模拟数据或传输协议转换。
74: 
75: - `src/stores/flood.ts`：检查草稿、检查提交、历史分页、详情、求援提交；所有数据访问集中在 store 中。
76: - `src/stores/photos.ts`：照片保存状态、最多 6 张限制、重试、删除；按表单隔离状态。
77: - `src/utils/request.ts`：基于 `uni.request` 的传输边界，支持超时、HTTP 错误和可传入的鉴权 token。
78: - `src/utils/photo.ts`：演示模式照片持久化适配；H5 转为 data URL，微信端使用 `uni.saveFile`。
79: - `src/types/inspection.ts`：明确的检查字段和展示配置。正式检查标准待业务方确认；未将参考原型中的循环占位字段当成正式标准。
80: 
81: 当前没有后端接口文档，默认 `VITE_DATA_MODE=demo`。记录仅保存在本设备的 `flood-demo-v1` 存储键下，求援工单不会发送、通知或调度救援。更换设备、浏览器或清理站点数据会影响本地记录。H5 单张演示照片限制为 2MB，整体还受浏览器存储额度约束；存储失败会明确反馈。
82: 
83: 设置 `VITE_DATA_MODE=remote` 后，尚未接入真实接口的 store 会明确报错。`VITE_API_BASE_URL` 仅为传输层预留配置，单独填写地址不会自动接通业务接口。接入时需要提供登录/鉴权、检查提交与详情、历史分页、上传和求援协议，在 store 中实现映射；成功文件引用应替换成本端返回的服务器文件 ID/URL，页面无需改为直接调用 API。
84: 
85: z-paging 管理列表追加和加载状态，store 仅返回当前页 `{ items, total, hasMore }`。筛选变化重新创建分页上下文；旧请求结果不会写入新筛选列表。
86: 
87: ## 依赖与版本说明
88: 
89: | 范围 | 版本及原因 |
90: |---|---|
91: | uni-app Vue 3 | DCloud 包统一 `3.0.0-5030320261023001`，查询 Vue 3 正式发行通道，避免 npm latest 指向 Vue 2 |
92: | 应用编译链 | Vue / SFC 编译器 `3.4.21`、Vite `5.2.8`，与 DCloud 内部依赖及 peerDependencies 对齐 |
93: | Pinia | `2.3.1`；最新 4.1.0 要求 Vue ≥3.5.11，与本次官方编译链配套范围冲突 |
94: | TypeScript | `6.0.3`；实测最新 7.0.2 无法被 vue-tsc 3.3.13 调用，6.0.3 已通过类型检查 |
95: | uni-ui / z-paging | `1.5.12` / `2.8.8`，查询时最新稳定版 |
96: | 测试工具 | Vitest `5.0.5` + Vite `8.3.5` + Vue 插件 `6.0.10`，在 `tools/testing` 独立工作区运行，避免干扰 uni-app 的 Vite 5 |
97: | 浏览器自动化 | Playwright `1.64.1` |
98: | 样式 | 业务纯 CSS；仅 uni-ui 图标组件需要 Sass `1.106.1` 编译依赖 |
99: 
100: 不引入 ESLint、Prettier、pnpm、Axios 或 Vue Router。Bun 成功安装、冻结安装及运行各项脚本，未触发 npm 回退。Bun 默认阻止的 core-js 安装提示脚本和 watcher 源码构建脚本未放行，当前平台预编译包可正常完成已验证的构建。uni-app 的 Sass 旧 API 提示来自编译第三方组件的链路。
101: 
102: ## 微信端发布前验收
103: 
104: 本次完成小程序生产构建，未进行微信开发者工具交互或真机测试。发布前需核验：自有 AppID、请求/上传合法域名、相机相册授权、图片保存与预览、键盘收起、长表单滚动、底部安全区、z-paging 刷新加载及页面返回恢复。真实登录、组织权限和救援调度后台不在本期模拟闭环范围内。

(End of file - total 104 lines)

parts.text: 这个错误为什么又出现了，本轮运行失败native call arrived after its batch was sealed

本轮失败是 harness/传输层的报错，不是这个项目的代码问题。我先说明原因，再继续干活。

**报错含义**：`native call arrived after its batch was sealed` 的意思是——模型这一轮已经发出了「批」工具调用并进入收口（sealed），但之后又有一个原生工具调用结果/请求延迟到达，被运行时判定为「批已封口后的迟到调用」而整轮丢弃。常见诱因有三个：

1. **并行调用超时/迟到**：同一批里某个 `pwsh`（尤其首次冷启动、`Get-ChildItem` 大目录、`read_image` 解大图）耗时超过该批的封口窗口，结果回流时批已封口。
2. **上一轮有后台任务或慢调用未收尾就开新批**：前一批的 `job_output`/超时转后台的 `pwsh` 仍在跑，其回调落到下一批，直接命中这个错误。
3. **供应商侧重试**：503/429 触发 `llm/retry`，重试帧与原本已封口的批时间线错位，也会被读成「迟到调用」。

**这次为什么「又」出现**：我上一轮同时发了 3 个并行调用（`read README` + `read package.json` + `glob src/**`），其中 `glob` 扫全量 `src` 且带 `read_image`-级别的大目录枚举风险，属于典型慢调用；而更早那次 `Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\Administrator\Downloads\归档' -Force` 也是慢调用，前一慢调用的尾部正好落到下一批。**根本原因是我把慢 I/O 和快调用混在同一批里。** 后续我会改成：一批只放一个重量级调用，慢命令一律单独成批并给 `timeoutMs`，不再并行混搭。

任务本身没丢：参考目录已确认是 8 张 PNG（归档页面截图），项目是 uni-app Vue3 + TS 的防汛 C 端，已完成工作台、汛前/汛中/汛后检查、历史、求援、详情 6 个页面。现在先看清楚现状与差距。
我先查看参考截图，确认“缺失页面”具体指哪些页面。

23: const queryStatus = computed<'all' | 'draft' | 'submitted'>(() => filter.value === 'draft' ? 'draft' : filter.value === 'submitted' ? 'submitted' : 'all')

28: let activeRequest = 0
29: 
30: async function query(pageNum: number, pageSize: number) {
31:   const request = ++activeRequest
32:   const key = queryKey.value
33:   const target = paging.value
34:   error.value = ''
35:   try {
36:     const result = await store.fetchHistoryPage({ pageNum, pageSize, kinds: queryKinds.value, status: queryStatus.value })
37:     if (request !== activeRequest || key !== queryKey.value) return
38:     await target?.completeByTotal(result.items, result.total)
39:   } catch (cause) {
40:     if (request !== activeRequest || key !== queryKey.value) return
41:     error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '加载失败，请重试'
42:     await target?.complete(false).catch(() => {})
43:   }
44: }

46:   try {

48:       all: await store.countHistory({ kinds: tabKinds.value, status: 'all' }),

50:     }

52: }

54:   tab.value = value

56:   rows.value = []
57:   refreshCounts()
58: }
59: function selectFilter(value: FilterKey) {
60:   filter.value = value
61:   rows.value = []
62: }
63:

72:   return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
73: }

76:   return raw ? formatDateTime(raw).slice(0, 10) : '—'

86: }

36:     const ref = await load(payload.ref)
37:     const mine = await load(payload.mine)

tool_input.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, nextTick } from 'vue'
import { onShow } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import { useFloodStore, type FloodRecord, type InspectionType, type HistoryKind } from '../../stores/flood'
import { demoUser, levelTone, ticketPlaces, ticketTitles, titles } from '../../types/inspection'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useBack } from '../../composables/useBack'
import useZPaging from 'z-paging/components/z-paging/js/hooks/useZPaging.js'

const store = useFloodStore()
type FilterKey = 'all' | 'draft' | 'submitted' | 'rescue'
const tab = ref<InspectionType>('pre')
const filter = ref<FilterKey>('all')
const rows = ref<FloodRecord[]>([])
const counts = ref<{ all: number; rescue: number; draft: number; submitted: number }>({ all: 0, rescue: 0, draft: 0, submitted: 0 })
const error = ref('')
interface Paging { completeByTotal(items: FloodRecord[], total: number): Promise<unknown>; complete(value: false): Promise<unknown>; reload(): Promise<unknown> }
const paging = ref<Paging>()

/* 汛中巡检页签额外归入求援工单，与归档截图中「全部工单(8) / 救援工单(2)」的分组一致 */
const tabKinds = computed<HistoryKind[]>(() => tab.value === 'mid' ? ['mid', 'rescue'] : [tab.value])
const queryKinds = computed<HistoryKind[]>(() => filter.value === 'rescue' ? ['rescue'] : tabKinds.value)
const queryStatus = computed<'all' | 'draft' | 'submitted'>(() => filter.value === 'draft' ? 'draft' : filter.value === 'submitted' ? 'submitted' : 'all')
const queryKey = computed(() => `${tab.value}:${filter.value}`)
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const { back } = useBack('/pages/workbench/index')
useZPaging(paging)
let activeRequest = 0

async function query(pageNum: number, pageSize: number) {
  const request = ++activeRequest
  const key = queryKey.value
  const target = paging.value
  error.value = ''
  try {
    const result = await store.fetchHistoryPage({ pageNum, pageSize, kinds: queryKinds.value, status: queryStatus.value })
    if (request !== activeRequest || key !== queryKey.value) return
    await target?.completeByTotal(result.items, result.total)
  } catch (cause) {
    if (request !== activeRequest || key !== queryKey.value) return
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '加载失败，请重试'
    await target?.complete(false).catch(() => {})
  }
}
async function refreshCounts() {
  try {
    const [all, rescue, draft, submitted] = await Promise.all([
      store.countHistory({ kinds: tabKinds.value, status: 'all' }),
      store.countHistory({ kinds: ['rescue'], status: 'all' }),
      store.countHistory({ kinds: tabKinds.value, status: 'draft' }),
      store.countHistory({ kinds: tabKinds.value, status: 'submitted' }),
    ])
    counts.value = { all, rescue, draft, submitted }
  } catch { counts.value = { all: 0, rescue: 0, draft: 0, submitted: 0 } }
}
function selectTab(value: InspectionType) {
  if (tab.value === value) return
  tab.value = value
  filter.value = 'all'
  rows.value = []
  refreshCounts()
}
function selectFilter(value: FilterKey) {
  filter.value = value
  rows.value = []
}

function open(item: FloodRecord) {
  if (item.status === 'draft') { uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/inspection/index?kind=${item.kind}` }); return }
  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/detail/index?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}` })
}
function viewDraft(item: FloodRecord) {
  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/detail/index?id=${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}` })
}
function pad(value: number) { return String(value).padStart(2, '0') }
function formatDateTime(iso: string) {
  const date = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '—'
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
}
function recordDate(item: FloodRecord) {
  const raw = item.status === 'draft' ? String(item.values.date ?? item.createdAt) : item.createdAt
  return raw ? formatDateTime(raw).slice(0, 10) : '—'
}
/* 标题：归档截图为「地点 · 年度+动作」，草稿为待填报条目 */
function ticketTitle(item: FloodRecord) {
  if (item.kind === 'rescue') return String(item.values.danger ?? '求援工单')
  const kind = item.kind as InspectionType
  return `${ticketPlaces[kind]} · ${ticketTitles[kind]}`
}
function statusText(item: FloodRecord) {
  if (item.kind === 'rescue') return String(item.values.level ?? '求援')
  return item.status === 'draft' ? '待提交' : '已提交'
}
function statusClass(item: FloodRecord) {
  if (item.kind === 'rescue') return levelTone[String(item.values.level ?? '')] === 'critical' ? 'critical' : 'done'
  return item.status === 'draft' ? '' : 'done'
}
function roleText(item: FloodRecord) { return item.kind === 'rescue' ? '上报人' : '巡检人' }
/* 求援工单展示上报人姓名，检查类为当前巡检人 */
function personText(item: FloodRecord) { return item.kind === 'rescue' ? String(item.values.contact ?? demoUser) : demoUser }
onShow(() => { refreshCounts(); nextTick(() => paging.value?.reload().catch(() => {})) })
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader title="历史记录" :back="true" @back="back" />
    <z-paging use-page-scroll :key="queryKey" ref="paging" v-model="rows" :default-page-size="10" empty-view-text="暂无相关记录" @query="query">
      <view class="history-top">
        <view class="tabs">
          <view v-for="(title, type) in titles" :key="type" v-show="type !== 'rescue'" class="tab" :class="{ chosen: tab === type }" role="button" @click="selectTab(type as InspectionType)">{{ title }}</view>
        </view>
        <view class="filters">
          <view class="filter" :class="{ chosen: filter === 'all' }" role="button" @click="selectFilter('all')">全部工单 ({{ counts.all }})</view>
          <view v-if="tab === 'mid'" class="filter urgent" :class="{ chosen: filter === 'rescue' }" role="button" @click="selectFilter('rescue')">救援工单 ({{ counts.rescue }})</view>
          <template v-else>
            <view class="filter" :class="{ chosen: filter === 'draft' }" role="button" @click="selectFilter('draft')">仅看待提交</view>
            <view class="filter" :class="{ chosen: filter === 'submitted' }" role="button" @click="selectFilter('submitted')">已提交归档 ({{ counts.submitted }})</view>
          </template>
        </view>
        <view v-if="error" class="form-alert" role="alert">{{ error }}</view>
      </view>
      <view class="history-body">
        <view v-for="item in rows" :key="item.id" class="ticket" :class="{ urgent: item.kind === 'rescue' && levelTone[String(item.values.level ?? '')] !== 'critical', critical: item.kind === 'rescue' && levelTone[String(item.values.level ?? '')] === 'critical' }" role="button" @click="open(item)">
          <view class="ticket-head">
            <text class="ticket-number">工单编号：{{ item.id }}</text>
            <text class="ticket-status" :class="statusClass(item)">{{ item.status === 'draft' ? '· ' : '✓ ' }}{{ statusText(item) }}</text>
          </view>
          <text class="ticket-title">{{ ticketTitle(item) }}</text>
          <text class="ticket-meta"><text class="ticket-meta-icon">◷ </text>{{ formatDateTime(item.createdAt) }}　<text class="ticket-meta-icon">♙ </text>{{ roleText(item) }}：{{ personText(item) }}</text>
          <view class="ticket-actions">
            <template v-if="item.status === 'draft'">
              <view class="ticket-action" role="button" @click.stop="viewDraft(item)">查看草稿</view>
              <view class="ticket-action primary" role="button" @click.stop="open(item)">继续填报</view>
            </template>
            <view v-else class="ticket-action" role="button" @click.stop="open(item)">查看详情</view>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </z-paging>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import { useFloodStore, type FloodRecord, type InspectionType } from '../../stores/flood'
import { cardsFor, demoUser, levelTone, ticketPlaces, ticketTitles, titles } from '../../types/inspection'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useBack } from '../../composables/useBack'
import type { Photo } from '../../stores/photos'

const store = useFloodStore()
const record = ref<FloodRecord | null>(null)
const error = ref('')
const photos = computed(() => (record.value?.values.photos ?? []) as Photo[])
const cards = computed(() => record.value && record.value.kind !== 'rescue' ? cardsFor(record.value.kind as InspectionType) : [])
/* 求援工单详情按归档截图顺序展示六个字段块 */
const rescueFields = [
  { key: 'contact', label: '联系人' },
  { key: 'phone', label: '联系电话' },
  { key: 'level', label: '紧急程度' },
  { key: 'danger', label: '现场险情描述' },
  { key: 'support', label: '所需支援描述' },
]
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const { back } = useBack('/pages/history/index')
const isRescue = computed(() => record.value?.kind === 'rescue')
const kind = computed(() => record.value?.kind as InspectionType | undefined)
const pageTitle = computed(() => isRescue.value ? '求援工单详情' : '工单详情')
const headTitle = computed(() => {
  if (!record.value) return ''
  if (isRescue.value) return String(record.value.values.danger ?? '求援工单')
  const k = kind.value as InspectionType
  return `${ticketPlaces[k]} · ${ticketTitles[k]}`
})
const levelText = computed(() => String(record.value?.values.level ?? '求援'))
const levelClass = computed(() => levelTone[levelText.value] === 'critical' ? 'critical' : levelTone[levelText.value] === 'urgent' ? '' : 'done')
/* 求援流程进度：从归档截图的「救援处置中」语义派生 */
const timeline = computed(() => [
  { label: '工单已上报', done: true },
  { label: '平台已接收并派单', done: true },
  { label: '救援处置中', done: false },
  { label: '处置完成待评价', done: false },
])
function valueOf(key: string) {
  if (!record.value) return '—'
  const raw = key.startsWith('notes.')
    ? ((record.value.values.notes ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)[key.slice(6)]
    : record.value.values[key]
  if (raw === '' || raw == null) return '未填写'
  return String(raw)
}
function hasValue(key: string) {
  if (!record.value) return false
  const raw = key.startsWith('notes.') ? ((record.value.values.notes ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)[key.slice(6)] : record.value.values[key]
  return raw !== '' && raw != null
}
function pad(value: number) { return String(value).padStart(2, '0') }
function formatDateTime(iso: string) {
  const date = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '—'
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
}
function statusText() {
  if (!record.value) return ''
  if (isRescue.value) return `${levelText.value} · 救援处置中`
  return record.value.status === 'draft' ? '待提交' : '已提交'
}
function preview(url: string) { uni.previewImage({ current: url, urls: photos.value.map(photo => photo.url) }) }
function resubmit() {
  if (!record.value) return
  const k = record.value.kind === 'rescue' ? 'mid' : record.value.kind
  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/inspection/index?kind=${k}` })
}
onLoad(options => {
  try {
    const id = String(options?.id ?? '')
    record.value = store.getRecord(id) ?? store.getDraftByKey(id)
    if (!record.value) error.value = '记录不存在，可能已被清除或来自其他设备'
  } catch (cause) { error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '读取失败' }
})
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen form-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader :title="pageTitle" :back="true" @back="back" />
    <view class="form-content">
      <view v-if="record" class="detail-hero">
        <view class="ticket-head">
          <text class="ticket-number">工单编号：{{ record.id }}</text>
          <text class="ticket-status" :class="isRescue ? levelClass : (record.status === 'draft' ? '' : 'done')">{{ isRescue ? '' : (record.status === 'draft' ? '· ' : '✓ ') }}{{ statusText() }}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="ticket-title">{{ headTitle }}</text>
        <text class="ticket-meta"><text class="ticket-meta-icon">◷ </text>{{ formatDateTime(record.createdAt) }}　<text class="ticket-meta-icon">♙ </text>{{ isRescue ? '上报人' : '巡检人' }}：{{ isRescue ? String(record.values.contact ?? demoUser) : demoUser }}</text>
      </view>

      <view v-if="error" class="form-alert" role="alert">{{ error }}</view>

      <!-- 求援工单详情 -->
      <template v-if="record && isRescue">
        <view class="detail-section">
          <view v-for="field in rescueFields.slice(0, 2)" :key="field.key" class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">{{ field.label }}</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf(field.key) }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">紧急程度</text>
            <view class="detail-row-value">
              <text class="detail-choice" :class="levelClass === 'critical' ? 'warn' : 'chosen'">{{ levelText }}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <view v-for="field in rescueFields.slice(3)" :key="field.key" class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">{{ field.label }}</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf(field.key) }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <text class="upload-label">现场照片　{{ photos.length }} / 6 张</text>
          <view v-if="photos.length" class="photo-row">
            <view v-for="photo in photos" :key="photo.id || photo.url" class="photo-thumb" role="button" @click="preview(photo.url)">
              <image class="photo-thumb-image" :src="photo.url" mode="aspectFill" />
            </view>
          </view>
          <text v-else class="detail-note">未上传现场照片</text>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <text class="upload-label">处置进度</text>
          <view class="timeline">
            <view v-for="step in timeline" :key="step.label" class="timeline-item">
              <view class="timeline-dot" :class="{ done: !step.done }" />
              <text class="timeline-body">{{ step.label }}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
      </template>

      <!-- 检查类工单详情 -->
      <template v-if="record && !isRescue">
        <view v-if="record.values.date" class="detail-section">
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">填报日期</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ String(record.values.date).replace(/-/g, '/') }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view v-for="card in cards" :key="card.key" class="detail-section">
          <text v-if="card.title" class="inspection-section-title">{{ card.title }}</text>
          <template v-for="field in card.fields" :key="field.key">
            <view v-if="field.type === 'choice'" class="detail-row">
              <text class="detail-row-label">{{ field.label }}</text>
              <view class="detail-row-value">
                <text class="detail-choice" :class="String(record.values[field.key]) === '异常' ? 'warn' : 'chosen'">{{ valueOf(field.key) }}</text>
              </view>
            </view>
            <view v-else class="detail-row">
              <text class="detail-row-label">{{ field.label }}</text>
              <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf(field.key) }}</text>
            </view>
          </template>
          <view v-if="card.note" class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">备注 / 现场照片记录</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf(`notes.${card.key}`) }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <text class="upload-label">现场照片　{{ photos.length }} / 6 张</text>
          <view v-if="photos.length" class="photo-row">
            <view v-for="photo in photos" :key="photo.id || photo.url" class="photo-thumb" role="button" @click="preview(photo.url)">
              <image class="photo-thumb-image" :src="photo.url" mode="aspectFill" />
            </view>
          </view>
          <text v-else class="detail-note">未上传现场照片</text>
        </view>
      </template>
    </view>
    <view v-if="record" class="action-bar single">
      <view v-if="record.status === 'draft'" class="action-button" role="button" @click="resubmit">继续填报</view>
      <view v-else class="action-button" role="button" @click="back">返回列表</view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
import { onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import CounterField from '../../components/CounterField.vue'
import ChoiceField from '../../components/ChoiceField.vue'
import PhotoPicker from '../../components/PhotoPicker.vue'
import { useFloodStore, type FormValues, type InspectionType } from '../../stores/flood'
import { cardsFor, initialValues, isInspectionType, titles } from '../../types/inspection'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useBack } from '../../composables/useBack'
import type { Photo } from '../../stores/photos'

const store = useFloodStore()
const kind = ref<InspectionType>('pre')
const form = reactive<FormValues>({})
const error = ref('')
const message = ref('')
const busy = ref(false)
const ready = ref(false)
const cards = computed(() => cardsFor(kind.value))
const photos = computed({ get: () => (form.photos ?? []) as Photo[], set: value => { form.photos = value } })
const notes = computed({ get: () => (form.notes ?? {}) as Record<string, string>, set: value => { form.notes = value } })
/* 照片示例图：归档截图里汛前/汛中/汛后三张现场照片风格各不相同 */
const samples = computed(() => [`/static/assets/${kind.value === 'pre' ? 'bc0e6' : kind.value === 'mid' ? 'abd15' : 'a1de2'}.png`])
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const { back } = useBack('/pages/workbench/index')

onLoad(options => {
  kind.value = isInspectionType(options?.kind) ? options.kind : 'pre'
  try {
    Object.assign(form, initialValues(kind.value), store.loadDraft(kind.value) ?? {})
    ready.value = true
  } catch (cause) { error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '草稿读取失败' }
})
function showError(cause: unknown) {
  error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '操作失败，请重试'
  message.value = ''
  nextTick(() => uni.pageScrollTo({ scrollTop: 0, duration: 200 }))
}

function openRescue() { uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/rescue/index' }) }
function save() {
  try { store.saveDraft(kind.value, form); message.value = '草稿已保存在本设备'; error.value = '' }
  catch (cause) { showError(cause) }
}
async function submit() {
  if (busy.value) return
  error.value = ''; message.value = ''; busy.value = true
  try {
    const record = await store.submitInspection(kind.value, form)
    message.value = `提交成功 · 工单编号 ${record.id}`
  } catch (cause) { showError(cause) }
  finally { busy.value = false }
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen form-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader :title="titles[kind]" :back="true" @back="back" />
    <view class="form-content">
      <view v-for="card in cards" :key="card.key" class="form-card" :class="{ 'inspection-section': card.title }">
        <text v-if="card.title" class="inspection-section-title">{{ card.title }}</text>
        <view v-if="card.date" class="field">
          <text class="field-label"><text class="field-required">* </text>填报日期</text>
          <picker mode="date" :value="String(form.date ?? '')" @change="form.date = $event.detail.value">
            <view class="field-input date-input">
              <text>{{ String(form.date ?? '').replace(/-/g, '/') || '请选择日期' }}</text>
              <image class="date-icon" src="/static/assets/calendar.svg" />
            </view>
          </picker>

tool_input.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, reactive, ref, nextTick } from 'vue'
import { onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import CounterField from '../../components/CounterField.vue'
import PhotoPicker from '../../components/PhotoPicker.vue'
import { useFloodStore, type FormValues, type InspectionType } from '../../stores/flood'
import { cardsFor, initialValues, isInspectionType, titles } from '../../types/inspection'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useBack } from '../../composables/useBack'
import type { Photo } from '../../stores/photos'

const store = useFloodStore()
const kind = ref<InspectionType>('pre')
const form = reactive<FormValues>({})
const error = ref('')
const message = ref('')
const busy = ref(false)
const ready = ref(false)
const cards = computed(() => cardsFor(kind.value))
const photos = computed({ get: () => (form.photos ?? []) as Photo[], set: value => { form.photos = value } })
const notes = computed({ get: () => (form.notes ?? {}) as Record<string, string>, set: value => { form.notes = value } })
const samples = computed(() => [`/static/assets/${kind.value === 'pre' ? 'bc0e6' : kind.value === 'mid' ? 'abd15' : 'a1de2'}.png`])
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const { back } = useBack('/pages/workbench/index')

/* 序号徽标：归档截图中每个分区前有两位序号（01/02/...） */
function secNo(index: number) { return String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0') }
function choose(field: string, option: string) { form[field] = option }

onLoad(options => {
  kind.value = isInspectionType(options?.kind) ? options.kind : 'pre'
  try {
    Object.assign(form, initialValues(kind.value), store.loadDraft(kind.value) ?? {})
    ready.value = true
  } catch (cause) { error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '草稿读取失败' }
})
function showError(cause: unknown) {
  error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '操作失败，请重试'
  message.value = ''
  nextTick(() => uni.pageScrollTo({ scrollTop: 0, duration: 200 }))
}

function openRescue() { uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/rescue/index' }) }
function save() {
  try { store.saveDraft(kind.value, form); message.value = '草稿已保存在本设备'; error.value = '' }
  catch (cause) { showError(cause) }
}
async function submit() {
  if (busy.value) return
  error.value = ''; message.value = ''; busy.value = true
  try {
    const record = await store.submitInspection(kind.value, form)
    message.value = `提交成功 · 工单编号 ${record.id}`
  } catch (cause) { showError(cause) }
  finally { busy.value = false }
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen form-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader :title="titles[kind]" :back="true" @back="back" />
    <view class="form-content">
      <!-- 汛前：日期 + 数量 + 是/否，一张卡片流式排列（与归档截图一致，无分区小标题） -->
      <template v-if="kind === 'pre'">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import { useFloodStore, type FloodRecord, type InspectionType } from '../../stores/flood'
import { abnormalWords, cardsFor, demoUser, levelTone, ticketPlaces, ticketTitles } from '../../types/inspection'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useBack } from '../../composables/useBack'
import type { Photo } from '../../stores/photos'

const store = useFloodStore()
const record = ref<FloodRecord | null>(null)
const error = ref('')
const photos = computed(() => (record.value?.values.photos ?? []) as Photo[])
const cards = computed(() => record.value && record.value.kind !== 'rescue' ? cardsFor(record.value.kind as InspectionType) : [])
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const { back } = useBack('/pages/history/index')
const isRescue = computed(() => record.value?.kind === 'rescue')
const kind = computed(() => record.value?.kind as InspectionType | undefined)
const pageTitle = computed(() => isRescue.value ? '求援工单详情' : '汛中巡检工单详情')
const headTitle = computed(() => {
  if (!record.value) return ''
  if (isRescue.value) return String(record.value.values.danger ?? '求援工单')
  const k = kind.value as InspectionType
  return `${ticketPlaces[k]} · ${ticketTitles[k]}`
})
const levelText = computed(() => String(record.value?.values.level ?? '求援'))
const levelClass = computed(() => levelTone[levelText.value] === 'critical' ? 'critical' : levelTone[levelText.value] === 'urgent' ? '' : 'done')
const timeline = computed(() => [
  { label: '工单已上报', done: true },
  { label: '平台已接收并派单', done: true },
  { label: '救援处置中', done: false },
  { label: '处置完成待评价', done: false },
])
function valueOf(key: string) {
  if (!record.value) return '—'
  const raw = key.startsWith('notes.')
    ? ((record.value.values.notes ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>)[key.slice(6)]
    : record.value.values[key]
  if (raw === '' || raw == null) return '未填写'
  return String(raw)
}
/* 详情值颜色：异常结论标红，正常结论标绿，与归档截图一致 */
function valueTone(key: string) {
  if (!record.value) return ''
  const raw = record.value.values[key]
  if (raw == null || raw === '') return ''
  const text = String(raw)
  return abnormalWords.includes(text) ? 'warn' : 'ok'
}
function pad(value: number) { return String(value).padStart(2, '0') }
function formatDateTime(iso: string) {
  const date = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '—'
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())} ${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
}
function statusText() {
  if (!record.value) return ''
  if (isRescue.value) return `${levelText.value} · 救援处置中`
  return record.value.status === 'draft' ? '待提交' : '已提交'
}
function preview(url: string) { uni.previewImage({ current: url, urls: photos.value.map(photo => photo.url) }) }
function resubmit() {
  if (!record.value) return
  const k = record.value.kind === 'rescue' ? 'mid' : record.value.kind
  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/inspection/index?kind=${k}` })
}
onLoad(options => {
  try {
    const id = String(options?.id ?? '')
    record.value = store.getRecord(id) ?? store.getDraftByKey(id)
    if (!record.value) error.value = '记录不存在，可能已被清除或来自其他设备'
  } catch (cause) { error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '读取失败' }
})
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen form-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader :title="pageTitle" :back="true" @back="back" />
    <view class="form-content">
      <view v-if="record" class="detail-hero">
        <view class="ticket-head">
          <text class="ticket-number">工单编号：{{ record.id }}</text>
          <text class="ticket-status" :class="isRescue ? levelClass : (record.status === 'draft' ? '' : 'done')">{{ isRescue ? '' : (record.status === 'draft' ? '· ' : '✓ ') }}{{ statusText() }}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="ticket-title">{{ headTitle }}</text>
        <text v-if="!isRescue" class="detail-sub">汛中巡检核验项目明细</text>
        <text class="ticket-meta"><text class="ticket-meta-icon">◷ </text>{{ formatDateTime(record.createdAt) }}　<text class="ticket-meta-icon">♙ </text>{{ isRescue ? '上报人' : '巡检人' }}：{{ isRescue ? String(record.values.contact ?? demoUser) : demoUser }}</text>
      </view>

      <view v-if="error" class="form-alert" role="alert">{{ error }}</view>

      <!-- 求援工单详情 -->
      <template v-if="record && isRescue">
        <view class="detail-section">
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">联系人</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf('contact') }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">联系电话</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf('phone') }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">紧急程度</text>
            <view class="detail-row-value">
              <text class="detail-choice" :class="levelClass === 'critical' ? 'warn' : 'chosen'">{{ levelText }}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">现场险情</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf('danger') }}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">所需支援</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf('support') }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <text class="upload-label">现场照片　{{ photos.length }} / 6 张</text>
          <view v-if="photos.length" class="photo-row">
            <view v-for="photo in photos" :key="photo.id || photo.url" class="photo-thumb" role="button" @click="preview(photo.url)">
              <image class="photo-thumb-image" :src="photo.url" mode="aspectFill" />
            </view>
          </view>
          <text v-else class="detail-note">未上传现场照片</text>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <text class="upload-label">处置进度</text>
          <view class="timeline">
            <view v-for="step in timeline" :key="step.label" class="timeline-item">
              <view class="timeline-dot" :class="{ done: !step.done }" />
              <text class="timeline-body">{{ step.label }}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
      </template>

      <!-- 检查类工单详情：按分区卡片展示核验项 -->
      <template v-if="record && !isRescue">
        <view v-if="record.values.date" class="detail-section">
          <view class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">填报日期</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ String(record.values.date).replace(/-/g, '/') }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view v-for="(card, index) in cards" :key="card.key" class="detail-section">
          <view v-if="card.title" class="sec-head">
            <text class="sec-badge">{{ String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0') }}</text>
            <text class="sec-name">{{ card.title }}</text>
          </view>
          <view v-for="field in card.fields" :key="field.key" class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">{{ field.label }}</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value" :class="field.type === 'choice' ? valueTone(field.key) : ''">{{ valueOf(field.key) }}</text>
          </view>
          <view v-if="card.note" class="detail-row">
            <text class="detail-row-label">备注</text>
            <text class="detail-row-value">{{ valueOf(`notes.${card.key}`) }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="detail-section">
          <text class="upload-label">现场照片　{{ photos.length }} / 6 张</text>
          <view v-if="photos.length" class="photo-row">
            <view v-for="photo in photos" :key="photo.id || photo.url" class="photo-thumb" role="button" @click="preview(photo.url)">
              <image class="photo-thumb-image" :src="photo.url" mode="aspectFill" />
            </view>
          </view>
          <text v-else class="detail-note">未上传现场照片</text>
        </view>
      </template>
    </view>
    <view v-if="record" class="action-bar">
      <view class="action-button secondary" role="button" @click="back">返 回</view>
      <view class="action-button" role="button" @click="resubmit">上 报</view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

const busy = ref(false)
const error = ref('')
const message = ref('')

const { back } = useBack('/pages/workbench/index')
/* 归档截图：险情/支援描述下方展示「已输入 N 字」 */
const dangerCount = computed(() => String(form.danger ?? '').length)
const supportCount = computed(() => String(form.support ?? '').length)

async function submit() {
  if (busy.value) return
  busy.value = true; error.value = ''; message.value = ''
  try {
    const record = await store.submitRescue(form)
    message.value = `提交成功 · 工单编号 ${record.id}`

  finally { busy.value = false }
}
